responseText:
When you're ready, we need all of our people joined up down the river at Bonfire. 

The way there isn't easy, mind you. Malae Kelori was one of the first of us downstream, she's posted up along the river to make sure folks like you make it all the way there. 

Look for her, and she'll guide you.
